ticket.title: verifying a cross-store dependency never unblocks its dependent, so a recorded cross-repo block can never be satisfied
ticket.description: Measured 2026-11-10, immediately after MTR-1 was verified. SP-40 carried a blocked_by edge to MTR-1 (recorded when SP-48 made cross-store edges possible), MTR-1 is now Verified in the miter store, and SP-40 still reads Blocked. The reason is the unblock half: verify_task walks its own store looking for Blocked dependents and records StatusChanged to Ready for those whose dependencies are satisfied, so a dependent in another repository is never visited. unpark does not rescue it either - it asks is_task_dependency_ready over the same local map, the foreign target is absent, and is_none_or treats an unknown target as unverified, so unpark parks it straight back to Blocked. That default is the safe one and I do not want it changed blindly: the fix is for readiness to consult the suite when a blocked_by target is not in this store, the same way SP-48 link resolution now does. Consequence for the burn-down: a cross-repository dependency can be recorded but never satisfied, which makes the edge advisory rather than blocking - worse than before SP-48, where it could not be recorded at all and the ticket simply read Ready and lied. Acceptance: verifying MTR-1 moves a dependent SP-40 in another store to Ready without touching SP-40; a dependent whose target is genuinely unverified stays Blocked; and a member-only checkout with the target repository absent keeps it Blocked rather than guessing.
